> A minimalist, tangible desk controller for local audio streaming. Uses an ESP32 and a NFC reader inside a custom 3D-modeled cassette dock. With NFC cards you trigger self-hosted audio playback directly on local smart speakers via Home Assistant and MQTT, completely subscription-free.

## Design

### 2026-10-20 – ### What I worked on

**2h**

### What I worked on
Executed the hardware, electrical, and parametric CAD engineering

   - Engineered a CAD architecture in OpenSCAD designed for 100% support-free FDM 3D printing.
   - Designed a two-part mini-cassette cartridge measuring 50 x 32 x 8.5 mm, featuring:
     - An internal captive pocket to encase the adhesive NFC sticker
          - M3 countersunk clearance holes flush with the front surface, clamping into M3 threaded brass heat-set insert towers inside the rear shell.
        - Slanted cartridge slot angled at 12° backwards with a 45° chamfered funnel entry for smooth blind-insertion.
     - Enforced a strictly constrained RF diaphragm wall of exactly 1.0 mm between the NFC antenna PCB and the cassette slot to ensure maximum magnetic field penetration at 13.56 MHz.
     - Engineered bottom plate with captive retention for the ESP32-C3 SuperMini
   - Standardized the entire mechanical bill of materials exclusively around M3 hardware and heat-set brass threaded inserts, eliminating fragile snap-fits and brittle magnets.
   - Defined the full SPI interconnect bus between the ESP32-C3 SuperMini and the MFRC522 module at 3.3V logic
